note: native application menu bar -- renders fixed operator vocabulary: File/Edit/Selection/View/Go/Run/Terminal/Help
activity bar and status bar icons -- renders fixed operator vocabulary: Explorer, Search, Source Control, Run, Extensions, Accounts, Settings
editor chrome -- renders fixed operator vocabulary for tab actions (close, preview, split, more); file names, breadcrumbs, and code content are subtracted
status bar -- renders fixed operator vocabulary for mode, EOL, encoding, indentation, and selection metrics
